```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load datasets
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Create adjacency matrix
boroughs = df['borough'].unique()
n = len(boroughs)
adj_matrix = np.zeros((n, n))

# Map borough names to indices
borough_to_idx = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}

# Fill adjacency matrix
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    i = borough_to_idx[row['borough']]
    j = borough_to_idx[row['neighbor']]
    adj_matrix[i, j] = 1
    adj_matrix[j, i] = 1  # Make symmetric

# Convert to row-standardized weights
weights = adj_matrix / adj_matrix.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
weights = np.nan_to_num(weights)  # Handle boroughs with no neighbors

# Get crime values as array
z = df['value'].values
z_mean = z.mean()
z_diff = z - z_mean

# Calculate Moran's I
numerator = np.sum(weights * np.outer(z_diff, z_diff))
denominator = np.sum(z_diff**2)
moran_i = (n / np.sum(weights)) * (numerator / denominator)

print("Moran's I:", moran_i)
```
